subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should this grouped refresh of security- and credential-sensitive GitHub Actions be accepted as one batch after the representative workflow checks pass?
rationale: The code changes are straightforward, but only the repository's automation and release owners can accept the combined trust-boundary and operational blast radius of replacing these action implementations.

options.title: Validate and merge the batch
options.body: Review the upstream revisions and require exact-head proof for representative token, CodeQL, Codex, Docker, and release lanes before merging the grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, CodeQL, and Docker action updates into smaller PRs so failures and security review can be attributed independently.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until the failed checks and any unavailable representative workflow proof can be resolved.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge the batch
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions and require exact-head proof for representative token, CodeQL, Codex, Docker, and release lanes before merging the grouped update.
